products.product_description: Deep Pit Seasoning, net wt. 6 oz., packaged in a clear, wide mouth jar, black and white label with black lid. The product label is read in parts: "***Deep-pit Seasoning *** Ingredients: (Hydrolyzed vegetable & soy protein, lactose, salt, partially hydrogenated cottonseed & soy oil, potato starch, caramel color), onion, garlic, canola oil, disodium inosinate & guanylate, oleoresin paprika, basil, red & black peppers, parsley, cilantro, lemon peel & extractive of turmeric*** Bounty Foods, Inc. ***P. O. Box 8510, Kalispell, MT 59904 (406) 756-1811***".
products.code_info: DPS08 12-31-22 which represents the product and the use by date.
products.reason_for_recall: Deep-pit Seasoning product is recalled due to undeclared wheat. In addition, the label declares lactose but did not declare milk.
